svg.title: Novu Box · Where it runs (simpler)
svg.desc: You and GitHub Actions reach box pr-123 through its address Worker, which forwards by name to the Box pr-123 Durable Object in novu-box-hub; its container runs the Novu stack and calls outside services, its disk is saved to a snapshot while asleep, and Slack reaches the Router Durable Object through novu-box-slack.
